t: Room in the king's palace in Memphis.
Interior of temple of Vulcano to Memphis.
One of the entrances of the city of Thebes.
The interior of the temple of Vulcano and the tomb of Radamès.
d: To the right and left a colonnade with statues and shrubs in flowers. Large door to the bottom, from which appear the temples, the palaces of Memphis and the pyramids. Radamès - Ramfis

A mysterious light descends from above. A long row of columns, one to the other leaning, is lost among the darkness. Statues of various gods. In the middle of the scene, over a stage covered with carpets, stands the altar surmounted by sacred emblems. From the golden tripods rises the smoke of incense. Priests and Priests - Ramfis at the foot of the altar - In his time, Radames - One can hear from within the song of the Priests accompanied by harps.
Amneris is surrounded by the Schiavas who encircle him for the triumphal feast. From the tripods rises the scent of aromas. Young Schiavi died dancing wave the fans of feathers.

On the front a group of palm trees. On the right the temple of Ammon - on the left a throne surmounted by a purple canopy. In the bottom a triumphal door. The scene is cluttered by the People. Enter the King, followed by the Ministers, Priests, Captains, Flabellifers, Doors insignia, etc., etc. Then, Amneris with Aida and Schiack - The King sits on the throne. Amneris takes place on the left of the King.
Rocks of granite among which grow palms. On the summit of the rocks the temple of Isis half hidden between the fronds. It is starry night. Moon shining.
On the left, a large door that puts to the underground room of sentences. Go right leading to Radamès prison. Amneris.

The scene is divided into two floors. The upper floor represents the interior of the temple of Vulcano shining of gold and light: the lower floor an underground. Long rows of arches are lost in the darkness. Colossal Statues of Osiris with crossed hands support the pillars of the vault. Radamès is in the underground on the steps of the staircase, so he descended. Upstairs, two Priests intent on closing the stone of the underground.
